description: Return the profile of one company: legal name, FinancialMD id, CIK, listings (ticker, exchange, currency), sector and industry, the statement template it is standardized with (for example industrial, bank, insurer), its fiscal year end, and the list of datasets available (which statements, ratios, filings, KPIs exist), the listing status (active, delisted with the date, or inactive), country and business address, former names, the newest head count with its source sentence (served only at confidence 0.90 or more) and cover-page shares per share class (never summed across classes). Call it before pulling statements to learn the template and fiscal calendar, and to confirm the identifier resolved to the right company.

company.description: Company identifier: a FinancialMD id ("fmd_01H..."), an SEC CIK ("cik:320193"), or a ticker ("ticker:AAPL", optionally with the MIC "ticker:AAPL.XNAS"). A bare ticker like "AAPL" is accepted and sent as ticker:AAPL. An issuer on an EU or UK regulated market that does not file with the SEC has no CIK: pass its LEI ("lei:IOG4E947OATN0KJYSD45") or its fmd_ id.

name: company_profile

outputSchema.description: The FinancialMD envelope (docs/API.md section 2): data plus meta (request_id, as_of knowledge time, matched company, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base). Every numeric value inside data is an object with value, unit, currency, period, known interval, restated flag, method and a proof pointing at the filing. On failure the result is isError with an error object instead.

data.description: Profile: fmd_id, cik, name, country, reporting_template, fiscal_year_end_month, status, sic_code, sector (SIC division), industry (SEC title of the SIC code), classification { scheme, sic_code, source_url, scheme_url } or null, listings (ticker, mic, currency, is_primary), available_datasets, updated_at, registry (sec, or esef for an EU or UK issuer), reporting_currency, accounting_standard, registrations [{ registry, local_id, id_kind, role, countries, source_url }].

error.description: Present only on isError results: the API error code and message plus remedy hints.

meta.description: Request metadata: request_id, as_of, company resolution, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base.

attribution.description: Citations a source requires on anything shown from the answer.

title: Company profile
